model_coordinate_frame: Purdue campus world coordinates in meters; X east, Y north, Z up; source GIS coordinates converted by project local approximation X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; no surveyed CRS is claimed.

sources.use: registered footprint, name, address, and official four-level count
sources.caveat: Footprint does not establish façade, roof, story heights, or interior layout; source height fields lack documented units.

sources.use: red brick and limestone exterior, window-transom/glazing interventions, hipped red tile roof, floor-2/3 research neighborhood layout, central communicating stair, floor-3 skylight, view to green roof, café/work areas
sources.caveat: Architectural photographs, not scaled drawings; modeled dimensions and exact façade rhythms remain estimates.

sources.use: building identity as former Helen B. Schleman Hall, 2024 renovation and atrium context; official project photos
sources.caveat: Interior images evidence materials, columns, furniture and stair character; no dimensioned floorplan found.

sources.use: program scale and planned four-story flagship context (approx. 86,000 sq ft was a 2019 plan)
sources.caveat: 2019 planned new building later differed; used only as broad scale context, not as as-built measurement.

sources.use: large interior concrete columns and green circuit-inspired graphic wraps
sources.caveat: Decoration not represented as extensive outdoor geometry.

verified.footprint: FID196 exact polygon ring carried into shell walls; source local projection is approximate campus conversion. Window/limestone projections extend slightly beyond ring as details.
verified.story_count: 4 official levels; floor heights and wall height estimated from photographs.
verified.material_palette: photo-supported Purdue red brick, pale limestone, dark glazing, bronze frames, terracotta roof tiles.
verified.interior: communicating stair, atrium columns, skylight, planted terrace, research tables and café are schematic and not dimensionally registered.

estimates_and_uncertainties: Exterior façade bay spacing and exact sill/head heights are photographic estimates.
Three hipped roof masses are simplified inferred geometry; no as-built roof plan located.
Interior plan placements are illustrative, based on architect narrative/photos, not floorplans.
GIS source elevation and height-related numeric fields were not used as metric heights because their units are undocumented.
Decorative band courses and corner quoins are inspired by exterior photos; exact positions are estimated.
